package ezclassify-rest-client (client/ezclassify_rest_client)

module ezclassify_rest_client
  __all__ = [CtxAccess, CtxCrosswalk, CtxDocument, CtxGuide, CtxScheme, EzClassifyClient, EzClassifyClientError, EzClassifyContext, MalformedResponseError, PingResult, RequestTimeoutError, RestClientCredentials, connect_context, utf8_byte_offset, utf8_index]

module ezclassify_rest_client.client
  class EzClassifyClient
    def __enter__(self) -> "EzClassifyClient"
    def __exit__(self, *_: Any) -> None
    def __init__(self, base_url: str, *, timeout: float = 30.0, headers: Dict[str, str] | None = None, credentials: RestClientCredentials | None = None) -> None
    def close(self) -> None
    def context(self, context_id: str, context_version: str | None = None, *, cache_access_decisions: bool = False, disable_cache: bool = False) -> "EzClassifyContext"
    def engine_spec_version(self) -> str
    def list_context_versions(self, context_id: str) -> List[str]
    def list_contexts(self) -> List[str]
    def ping(self) -> PingResult
  class EzClassifyClientError(Exception)
    def __init__(self, message: str, status_code: int = 0, *, code: str | None = None, detail: str | None = None, payload: Dict[str, Any] | None = None, retry_after: float | None = None) -> None
  class MalformedResponseError(EzClassifyClientError)
    def __init__(self, message: str, status_code: int, *, path: str) -> None
  @dataclass class PingResult
    engine_sha: str
    engine_version: str
    git_tag: str
  class RequestTimeoutError(EzClassifyClientError, TimeoutError)
  @dataclass(frozen=True) class RestClientCredentials
    def __post_init__(self) -> None
    access_token: str | None = None
    context_token: str | None = None
  logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

module ezclassify_rest_client.context
  class CtxAccess
